newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: OPTIONS -- Philips demand surprises market.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS -- Philips demand surprises market.

text.p: Philips once again caught the eye of investors on the European Options Exchange on Thursday, accounting for around 20 percent of turnover, but dealers were questioning the demand with business focusing on calls.
"It is surprising the stock (Philips) remained in positive territory for most of the day," said one dealer, adding the overall market was down and bound to slip further.

"The new (Philips) chairman and the recent U.S. book-to-bill data have given the stock some colour," said the dealer, adding the demand was largely psychological as it was not endorsed by recent turnover or profit figures.
"It would be better to stay sidelined and wait for the company's third quarter results first," the dealer said. The figures are due on October 24.
Dealers said Philips shares had risen quite a lot in recent months, from well under 50 guilders to around 64.10 guilders today.
Most trades were done in October calls at a 60 guilders strike at a 4.20 premium.
